g.text: How do scores compare against one shared policy reference?

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636a

g.text: High-load fixed-band actions | Same states, actions and full-data native 20k reference per seed | Final checkpoint

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636a

g.text: Reference is the full-data native 20k continuation for the same seed and context, not each model’s own policy. This is deviation from a common reference,

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636a

g.text: not operational accuracy for every policy. 21 ordinary / 32 strong-current anchors per seed; three correlated actions per anchor.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636a

g.text: MAE = mean absolute error in discounted-return units; U = BCA uncertainty score. Source: authenticated report 55cae667d369.
